result.topic_en: A dated list (May to July) of talks and experiments in a physics seminar, covering a Gauss bifilar magnetometer paper, barometric height measurement, the elasticity of vulcanized rubber, transverse string vibrations, bending of a rod with mirror and scale, and cooling rates measured with a Breguet thermometer.
